correctness.rationale: Analytic generating functions prove density. A unitary shift representation yields an explicit Jacobi matrix with compact tail and known constant essential band. The beta>=1 norm bound is sharp by the essential edge. For beta<1, disjoint sine blocks with positive K^-1 perturbation dominate the K^-3/2 finite-block defect and prove infinitely many simple outlier eigenvalues; positive top eigenvectors prove strict beta monotonicity. Exact formulas and two block certificates were checked against the standalone finite-section script; no finite test is used as infinite proof.
